mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO orders ( order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message ) VALUES ( #{orderNumber}, #{memberId}, #{requestKey}, #{orderType}, #{ordererName},
#{ordererPhone}, #{pickupName}, #{pickupPhone}, #{originalAmount}, #{discountAmount}, #{finalAmount}, #{status}, #{pickupAt}, #{paymentExpiresAt}, #{requestMessage} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET discount_amount = #{discountAmount}, final_amount = #{finalAmount} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items ( order_id, product_id, product_name, product_type, quantity, base_price, option_amount, total_amount, requirements, preparation_days, stock_deducted_at, stock_restored_at ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{productName}, #{productType}, #{quantity}, #{basePrice}, #{optionAmount}, #{totalAmount}, #{requirements}, #{preparationDays}, #{stockDeductedAt}, #{stockRestoredAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = payment.id WHERE payment.order_id = #{orderId} AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' AND cancellation.request_type IN ('CUSTOMER', 'ADMIN', 'ADMIN_REJECTION') )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_item_options ( order_item_id, product_option_id, option_group_name, option_name, additional_price ) VALUES ( #{orderItemId}, #{productOptionId}, #{optionGroupName}, #{optionName}, #{additionalPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, status, final_amount, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND request_key = #{requestKey}

SELECT id, order_number, payment_expires_at FROM orders WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY payment_expires_at, id LIMIT 1

SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT id AS order_id, order_number, orderer_name, order_type FROM orders WHERE id IN
#{orderId}

SELECT id, order_number, member_id, request_key, order_type, orderer_name, orderer_phone, pickup_name, pickup_phone, original_amount, discount_amount, final_amount, status, pickup_at, payment_expires_at, request_message, reject_reason, under_review_at, approved_at, rejected_at, rejected_by, ready_at, approved_by, picked_up_at, picked_up_by, expired_at, canceled_at, cancel_reason, canceled_by, pickup_reminder_sent_at, created_at, updated_at FROM orders
ORDER BY CASE status WHEN 'UNDER_REVIEW' THEN 0 WHEN 'IN_PRODUCTION' THEN 1 WHEN 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' THEN 2 WHEN 'PICKED_UP' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, pickup_at, created_at, id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT id FROM orders WHERE status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND payment_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND payment_expires_at <= #{now} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS candidate_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS compensation ON compensation.active_requested_payment_id = candidate_payment.id AND compensation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' WHERE candidate_payment.order_id = orders.id ) ORDER BY payment_expires_at, id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT orders.id FROM orders INNER JOIN order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.id WHERE orders.order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND orders.status = 'IN_PRODUCTION' AND orders.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND TIMESTAMPADD(DAY, order_items.preparation_days, orders.approved_at) <= #{now} ORDER BY orders.approved_at, orders.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_type, quantity, base_price, option_amount, total_amount, requirements, preparation_days, stock_deducted_at, stock_restored_at FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id

SELECT id, order_id, product_id, product_name, product_type, quantity, base_price, option_amount, total_amount, requirements, preparation_days, stock_deducted_at, stock_restored_at FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND stock_deducted_at IS NOT NULL AND stock_restored_at IS NULL ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT oio.id, oio.order_item_id, oio.product_option_id, oio.option_group_name, oio.option_name, oio.additional_price FROM order_item_options oio INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = oio.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id, oio.id

SELECT oii.id, oii.order_item_id, oii.image_url, oii.sort_order FROM order_item_images oii INNER JOIN order_items oi ON oi.id = oii.order_item_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY oi.id, oii.sort_order, oii.id
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = 'UNDER_REVIEW', under_review_at = #{underReviewAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', ready_at = #{readyAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'UNDER_REVIEW', under_review_at = #{underReviewAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', ready_at = #{readyAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS cancel_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = cancel_payment.id WHERE cancel_payment.order_id = orders.id AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'IN_PRODUCTION', approved_at = #{approvedAt}, approved_by = #{approvedBy} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS cancel_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = cancel_payment.id WHERE cancel_payment.order_id = orders.id AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', ready_at = #{readyAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'IN_PRODUCTION' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS cancel_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = cancel_payment.id WHERE cancel_payment.order_id = orders.id AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'REJECTED', rejected_by = #{rejectedBy}, rejected_at = #{rejectedAt}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'PICKED_UP', picked_up_by = #{pickedUpBy}, picked_up_at = #{pickedUpAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = 'READY_FOR_PICKUP' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'DONE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS cancel_payment INNER JOIN payment_cancellations AS cancellation ON cancellation.payment_id = cancel_payment.id WHERE cancel_payment.order_id = orders.id AND cancellation.status = 'REQUESTED' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_by = 'SYSTEM', canceled_at = #{canceledAt}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status IN ('PENDING_PAYMENT', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'EXPIRED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' AND payment.failure_code IN ('INTERNAL_COMPLETION_FAILED', 'GATEWAY_VOIDED') )

UPDATE orders AS current_order LEFT JOIN payments AS payment ON payment.order_id = current_order.id AND payment.status IN ('READY', 'DONE') SET current_order.status = 'EXPIRED', current_order.expired_at = #{expiredAt}, payment.status = 'EXPIRED', payment.failure_code = 'ORDER_EXPIRED' WHERE current_order.id = #{orderId} AND current_order.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND (payment.id IS NULL OR payment.status = 'READY') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payment_cancellations AS compensation WHERE compensation.active_requested_payment_id = payment.id AND compensation.request_type = 'SYSTEM_COMPENSATION' )

UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_by = #{canceledBy}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, canceled_at = #{canceledAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND status = #{expectedStatus} AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' ) AND order_type = 'GENERAL' AND status IN ('READY_FOR_PICKUP', 'UNDER_REVIEW') AND #{requestedAt} < pickup_at

UPDATE orders SET status = 'CANCELED', canceled_by = #{canceledBy}, cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, canceled_at = #{canceledAt} WHERE id = #{orderId} AND order_type = 'CUSTOM' AND status = 'UNDER_REVIEW' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM payments AS payment WHERE payment.order_id = orders.id AND payment.status = 'CANCELED' )
